messages:
maria: FYI AcmeCorp (acct: ACME-01) reported embedding calls returning 500s since ~08:41 PST. Support ticket #7891. Sales asking if we can accelerate a fix — hotfix vs next release decision needed.

alex: Can we get immediate triage? @kevin @sophie please advise on scope and risk.

kevin: quick repro locally — model selector falls back to an incompatible variant when sequence_len > 4096. Failing code path in runtime model routing, looks like a guard missing for newly onboarded embeddings model v2.

sophie: Oncall saw spike in errors only on the customer-dedicated pool us-west-2-dedicated-1. Error rate ~8% of embed calls. We can patch runtime to add the protective check.

maria: Customer is P1 and on a reserved dedicated fleet with SLA. Sales expects a fast path. They asked for ETA and whether we can avoid a full rollback.

lia: For Dedicated we can do a targeted hotfix to their pool. Plan: canary on 5% nodes -> monitor -> full roll. Need explicit approval for touching customer-managed dedicated pools from security/legal? (they're still under our management layer)

kevin: Patch is small (~8 LOC), added unit tests. Dev estimate: 2h to implement & test, 1h CI + canary, 30m rollout. Low risk but still must monitor KV cache behavior.

jasper: I can send an initial customer update. Proposed: "We are investigating and preparing a targeted fix; ETA ~4 hours. We will perform a brief canary and keep you informed." ok to send?

alex: Decision: proceed with hotfix targeted at the dedicated fleet. Product owns the comm plan, Eng owns PR + rollout, Support owns customer-facing updates. We will not wait for next release.

sophie: I'll coordinate the canary window. Suggest start at 10:30 PST for a 30m canary (5% nodes) then expand if metrics look good. I'll trigger the deploy and watch error_rate, 95p latency, and token throughput.

maria: :thumbsup: jasper please ping the account exec and ask if remote maintenance window is acceptable. Also capture whether they need a private status update channel.

jasper: Sending now to AcmeCorp: "We will initiate a targeted fix to your dedicated fleet at 10:30 PST; there may be brief disruptions. We will update within 2 hours or sooner." cc @nina

deploy-bot: canary-deploy started for acmecorp-dedicated-pool-1 — 5% nodes. link: https://deploys.redwood/prod/183999

lia: Run smoke checks post-canary: ./ops/smoke_acme.sh and verify embedding error_rate <0.1% and no regressions in latency. Also ensure canary logs are forwarded to the customer trace view.

kevin: PR opened: github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/4523 — small guard + unit tests. Kicking CI now; will merge on green and tag for canary.

statusbot: Incident created: INC-2026. Severity: P1. Public status page updated: "Investigating — targeted fix planned for affected dedicated fleets." internal-ops channel notified.

alex: Comms checklist: support to update customer, product to send an internal post to GTM (what to say to prospects), engineering to post deploy notes. Postmortem required after resolution; include Sales + Support reps.

maria: Owner matrix: Eng: kevin; Oncall: sophie; Support comms: jasper; Product PM: alex; Account exec: nina. I'll add a short agenda for the postmortem.

sophie: Canary looks good at +20m — error rate dropped to ~0.05% on canary nodes. Proceeding to full roll.

deploy-bot: full-deploy started for acmecorp-dedicated-pool-1. tracking: https://deploys.redwood/prod/183999/full

kevin: Full rollout completed. Running post-roll smoke: error_rate back to baseline (0.01%), no latency regression observed.

deploy-bot: deploy completed for acmecorp-dedicated-pool-1. duration: 18m. build: runtime@v2.14.7-patch.4523

jasper: Updated customer: "Fix deployed and verified. Please confirm on your side; we'll keep monitoring."

statusbot: Incident INC-2026 status changed to: Resolved (monitoring).

alex: Great execution. Next steps: 1) schedule postmortem within 48h, 2) prioritize adding automated regression test for sequence_len edge cases, 3) sync with Sales on contractual implications.

maria: Thanks team. I'll close this thread after postmortem scheduled. @nina I'll follow up on account-level notes.
